title: Astrometry agent polar alignment cases end with AGENT_START_PROCESS ALERT
summary: test_agent_astrometry: 'polar alignment and recalculation', 'polar alignment targets J2000 mount' and 'polar alignment targets JNow mount' fail with AGENT_START_PROCESS ALERT instead of OK on Linux x64 (2.0.0.31 and 2.0.0.32). Not investigated. Next: run with INDIGO_TEST_DEBUG=1 and find which polar alignment step fails.
evidence: task verification.md V4 and V6; indigo_test/integration/test_agent_astrometry.c:1100 and 1131

resolution.evidence: Task 20261025170920-4af2-astrometry-polar-test-references verification.md: the fake solver reported identical references, which indigo_polar_alignment_error_3p() refuses since 79dcf6d81; its new polar mode reports distinct references; recorded run 77/77.
